A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same LongReD research. Their main text, equations, five figures, 16 tables, and Appendices A–F are readable and can be matched reliably, with no material evidence gaps.

before.justification: v1 reports original context-extension experiments, benchmark evaluations, and ablations using Llama-3-8B and Mistral-7B-v0.3. Sections 3 and 5 and the appendices contain empirical outcomes.

after.justification: v3 retains the original training experiments, degradation analyses, benchmark comparisons, and ablations, including the detailed results in Appendix F.

M1.justification: The three training objectives, attention-KL-based layer selection, and CREAM/uniform skipped-position procedures remain unchanged in Section 4 and Appendix A. Added layer-selection citations do not alter the method.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same training mixtures in Appendix B and evaluate the same 17 short-text benchmarks and RULER in Appendix C. Newly cited benchmarks and applications do not constitute additional evaluated coverage.

E2.justification: The corresponding comparisons retain long-only and mixed-data continual pre-training in Table 3, and model merging and parameter-efficient tuning in Table 7. Added citations, including LongLoRA, do not introduce evaluated comparators.

E3.justification: Model configurations, context lengths, training budgets, data ratios, prompting settings, and metrics remain unchanged. Appendix C newly identifies evaluation libraries but does not report a change to the existing experimental protocol.

E4.justification: The distribution-drift and forgetting analyses, objective and loss-weight ablations, layer-selection comparisons, and distillation-length analysis are retained. Tables 4–6 and Appendix E's positional-vector analysis contain no added or revised experiments.

E5.justification: Both versions retain point-estimate reporting without repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests. No statistical reporting procedure is added or revised.

E6.justification: Corresponding tables and figures retain their values and findings, including Appendix F. For example, Table 3 reports the same 54.85 Short Avg. and 84.98 RULER scores for Llama-3-8B with 32K ABF and LongReD-C in both versions.

T1.justification: The distributional-discrepancy definitions, training equations, skipped-position formulations, and Appendix D.1 theorem and proof remain unchanged. Mathematical passages that move across page boundaries are retained without substantive revision.

C1.justification: Both versions identify distribution drift and catastrophic forgetting and claim that LongReD preserves short-text performance while maintaining competitive long-context capability. The claimed first systematic analysis and the main contributions retain their original scope.

C2.justification: Section 5.3 adds a tentative explanation of Table 7: the continual-learning comparators address forgetting, whereas LongReD also alleviates distribution drift through distillation. Existing interpretations and limitations concerning training scale and positional encodings remain unchanged.

D1.justification: v3 adds a code repository link in the abstract and specifies LLM-Box for most evaluations and OpenCompass for math-related benchmarks in Appendix C. These are new access and implementation disclosures; the documented hardware, hyperparameters, and training costs remain unchanged.

R1.justification: v3 adds contextual, methodological, and software references, including BAMBOO, LongLoRA, LLM-Box, OpenCompass, and recent reasoning and retrieval work. These expand attribution without substantially revising the related-work narrative or novelty positioning.

P1.justification: v3 makes limited grammar and wording edits, adds acknowledgements, and inserts brief interpretation and software-disclosure passages. The main section sequence and appendix organization remain unchanged, without extensive rewriting.

P2.justification: All five figures and 16 tables retain their content and design. Added text causes limited layout reflow, including a lower placement of Table 7 and references beginning on a separate page; there is no substantive display redesign.

improvement.justification: v3 modestly improves reproducibility documentation through the code-access link and explicit evaluation-library attribution in Appendix C. The added Table 7 explanation also clarifies the authors' interpretation, while remaining tentative. These address limited documentation gaps; the method, theoretical arguments, and empirical evidence are unchanged.
